hook.text:
Post three reels
this week
without editing
Post three reels this week without editing

effects.name: Highlight-bar hook
effects.say: your opening line in highlight bars
effects.earns: the first thing you say, when it has to be read before it is heard
effects.when: Every reel’s first frame. Highlight bars in your punch colour and ink, on screen from frame one.

effects.name: Compact punch hook
effects.say: a small opening line above your head
effects.earns: an opening where the shot is doing the work
effects.when: A quieter opener when the shot itself is the hook.

effects.name: Hook behind your head
effects.say: your opening line behind your head
effects.earns: an opening of two short words you want shouted
effects.when: Short, punchy titles (2 lines max) tucked behind your head.

effects.name: Stacked captions
effects.say: stacked captions with the loud word on top
effects.earns: the whole reel: the default caption look
effects.when: Default. your display font for the loud words, small your caption font between.

effects.name: Lead-in + punch word
effects.say: a quiet lead-in over one huge word
effects.earns: the whole reel, when single words carry it
effects.when: A small quiet lead-in above one huge word in your punch colour.

effects.name: One word at a time
effects.say: one word at a time
effects.earns: the whole reel, when it is slow and story-led
effects.when: Calmer, premium, story-led reels.

effects.name: Boxed captions
effects.say: captions in a box
effects.earns: the whole reel, when the background is busy or bright
effects.when: Busy or bright backgrounds where floating captions get lost.

effects.name: Blur-in captions
effects.say: captions that blur in
effects.earns: the whole reel, when it is reflective rather than punchy
effects.when: A softer caption entrance for slower, reflective reels.

effects.name: Checklist that fills in
effects.say: questions filling in one at a time
effects.earns: you ask people to check two or three things
effects.when: "Ask yourself these 3 questions" reels. One line fills in per point, as it’s said.

effects.name: End card
effects.say: a last card with your ask on it
effects.earns: the last line, where you ask for something
effects.when: Last 2 to 3 seconds: the keyword or "part 2".

effects.name: Giant word behind your head
effects.say: one giant word behind your head
effects.earns: a single word the whole reel hangs on
effects.when: The one word the reel hangs on, behind your head (ICON, LABEL).

effects.name: Serif numbers
effects.say: a big number in your quiet font
effects.earns: a numbered step, or one number said on its own
effects.when: Numbered steps and big moments ("1 2 3", "BETTER RESULT").

effects.name: Word struck through
effects.say: a word crossed out
effects.earns: you name the thing people should stop doing
effects.when: Killing an old idea on screen.

effects.name: Name label
effects.say: a name tag under what you said
effects.earns: you say a person, a step or a section name
effects.when: Introducing a person, step or section ("Step 1 · Photos").

effects.name: Accent label bar
effects.say: a name bar in your accent colour
effects.earns: you say your own show, product or company name
effects.when: Brand moments: your show, product or company name on a bar in your accent colour.

effects.name: Counter
effects.say: a number counting up
effects.earns: a number that changed, or grew
effects.when: Any number that changed: 300 to 3,000 plays.

effects.name: Slot-machine number
effects.say: a number rolling like a slot machine
effects.earns: a number that is the point of the reel
effects.when: A big reveal number (26 effects, $85K).

effects.name: Burning word
effects.say: a word burning onto the screen
effects.earns: a one-word verdict, and only once in a reel
effects.when: A dramatic one-liner ("COOKED."). Rarely.

effects.name: Glass type
effects.say: a glassy title behind you
effects.earns: you name a brand, platform or product
effects.when: A premium title behind you (a brand, platform or product name).

effects.name: Magazine cover
effects.say: the frame becomes a magazine cover
effects.earns: you start telling a story
effects.when: Story reels and "the story of…" openers.

effects.name: Paper cut
effects.say: a paper cut-out chapter break
effects.earns: you change subject and want it to feel light
effects.when: A playful chapter break, with a white sticker outline around you.

effects.name: Arrow note
effects.say: an arrow pointing at something in the shot
effects.earns: you point at something that is really in frame
effects.when: Pointing at me or something in frame ("can’t edit").

effects.name: Pinned question
effects.say: a question pinned to the top of the reel
effects.earns: the whole reel is answering one question
effects.when: Framing the whole reel as a question.

fx.text: Can Claude edit like a pro editor?

effects.name: Colour title
effects.say: the whole screen goes your accent colour behind you
effects.earns: an opening line, or a clean break between sections
effects.when: Opening line or chapter break: the background turns your accent colour, you stay in front.

effects.name: Screen behind you
effects.say: a screenshot or clip rising up behind you
effects.earns: you say exactly what the screenshot shows
effects.when: Real screenshots or b-roll of exactly what is being said, fading in behind you.

effects.name: Stacked shot, blur seam
effects.say: a second shot stacked above you, joined by a blur
effects.earns: you talk about someone or something you have footage of
effects.when: A guest or second angle on top, you below. Never a hard split.

effects.name: Photo fan
effects.say: photos fanning out like a hand of cards
effects.earns: you say a set of things: clients, episodes, products
effects.when: Showing a set of things (products, episodes, guests, clients).

effects.name: Camera snaps
effects.say: photos snapping in, one flash at a time
effects.earns: you tell people to go and take photos of something
effects.when: "Take photos of…" moments, one flash per photo.

effects.name: Photo wall
effects.say: a wall of photos
effects.earns: you claim volume: every client, every episode, all year
effects.when: Volume and proof (every reel, every client).

effects.name: Headline scatter
effects.say: headlines scattering around you
effects.earns: you mention press, reviews or DMs you have shots of
effects.when: Press, DMs or reviews landing around you.

effects.name: Orbit
effects.say: cards spinning around your head
effects.earns: you list tools, guests or platforms
effects.when: Cards circling you: tools, guests, platforms.

effects.name: Sticker
effects.say: a cut-out photo popping in beside you
effects.earns: you name one thing you have a photo of
effects.when: A logo or cut-out object popping in beside you.

effects.name: Icon strike
effects.say: a logo popping in and getting crossed out
effects.earns: you say you do not need a particular tool
effects.when: "You don’t need CapCut" moments.

effects.name: Folder drop
effects.say: files dropping into a folder
effects.earns: you say to put things all in one place
effects.when: "Put them all in one folder" moments.

effects.name: Phone with views
effects.say: a phone showing a real post, views ticking up
effects.earns: you talk about a post that actually did something
effects.when: Showing a real post, with its view count ticking up.

effects.name: Envelope reveal
effects.say: an envelope opening with your freebie in it
effects.earns: you offer something you will send people
effects.when: A free guide or lead magnet in the call to action.

effects.name: Brand swatches
effects.say: your brand colours fanning out
effects.earns: you talk about branding, colours or fonts
effects.when: Branding talk: brand colours and fonts fanning out.

effects.name: Receipts
effects.say: a receipt of what it costs, then struck out
effects.earns: you say what something costs
effects.when: What something costs, then striking it out.

effects.name: Prompt bar
effects.say: the exact prompt typing itself out
effects.earns: you say the words you typed
effects.when: The exact prompt, typing out.

effects.name: Prompt with files
effects.say: a prompt with your files dropped into it
effects.earns: you say you handed files over to something
effects.when: "I dropped my raw clips in…" moments.

fx.text: Edit my reel in my style

effects.name: Chat
effects.say: a real back-and-forth on screen
effects.earns: you quote both sides of a conversation
effects.when: A real back-and-forth with AI or a client.

msgs.text: Goal: post three reels this week.
On it. Which clips should I start from?

effects.name: Approval pile-up
effects.say: notifications piling up
effects.earns: you describe something multiplying until it is painful
effects.when: Showing a pain multiplying (approvals, notifications).

effects.name: Task list
effects.say: a job list ticking itself off
effects.earns: you walk through a process that runs without you
effects.when: A process ticking itself off.

effects.name: Calendar
effects.say: a week filling in on a calendar
effects.earns: you talk about posting or planning across days
effects.when: A content plan or posting week.

effects.name: Dropdown pick
effects.say: a menu opening and one option getting picked
effects.earns: you say you chose one setting or model
effects.when: Choosing a model, setting or option.

effects.name: Effort dial
effects.say: a dial turning up to max
effects.earns: you say to do more of something
effects.when: “Turn it up to max” moments.

effects.name: Struck-out note
effects.say: a note with the lines crossed out
effects.earns: you list what people do not need
effects.when: "You don’t need X" lists.

effects.name: Tool spotlight
effects.say: a grid of tools, then one steps forward
effects.earns: you say the one that actually matters is
effects.when: "The one that matters is…": a grid, then one steps forward.

effects.name: Stat bars
effects.say: bars growing, before and after
effects.earns: you compare two numbers out loud
effects.when: Show stats, before and after.

effects.name: Flow arrows
effects.say: arrows walking through the steps
effects.earns: you say first, then, then
effects.when: Any process, step by step, on the explainer board.

effects.name: Glowing chart
effects.say: a line climbing up a chart
effects.earns: you describe growth over time
effects.when: Growth over time (downloads, followers, revenue).

effects.name: Edit timeline
effects.say: an editing timeline scrubbing past
effects.earns: you talk about editing or making the thing
effects.when: Talking about editing or production.

effects.name: App background
effects.say: the whole background becomes the app
effects.earns: you name the app you are working inside
effects.when: The whole background becomes the app you are using.

fx.text: Edit my reel in my style

effects.name: DM card
effects.say: a DM landing with your keyword in it
effects.earns: you ask people to send you a word
effects.when: The comment-keyword call to action, with the reply landing.

effects.name: Comment box
effects.say: your keyword typing into a comment box
effects.earns: you ask people to comment a word
effects.when: CTA: the keyword typing into a comment, then Follow.

effects.name: Frame break
effects.say: you pop out of the frame
effects.earns: the biggest moment in the reel, once
effects.when: A big moment: you pop out of the frame.

effects.name: Pull-back reveal
effects.say: the camera pulls back to show how it was made
effects.earns: you reveal how the thing was actually done
effects.when: Revealing the process behind the video.

effects.name: Doodle outline
effects.say: a doodle outline drawn around you
effects.earns: a light or funny aside
effects.when: Light, funny moments.

effects.name: Zoom-blur cut
effects.say: a zoom-blur jump to the next point
effects.earns: you move on to the next point
effects.when: Jumping to the next point.

effects.name: Paper rip
effects.say: the screen tears like paper
effects.earns: you change topic or location hard
effects.when: Hard change of topic or location.

effects.name: Glitch cut
effects.say: a glitch cut
effects.earns: a quick switch, usually about tech
effects.when: Tech moments, quick switches.

effects.name: Light flash
effects.say: a flash of light
effects.earns: a jump in time, once in a reel
effects.when: Time jumps. Once a reel, max.
